chapter.verse: Topa in tuu cin’ bang-a kei hong cingpa hi a, bangmah ka kisam kei ding hi.
Lo nona-ah keimah hong lumsak a, tui kiangah kei hong paipih hi.
Ka nuntakna tha hong dimsak a, ama min’ adingin thuman lampi-ah kei hong kha hi.
Sihna lim guam sung nangawn ka nawk hangin, siatna ka kihta kei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei tawh nang nong omkhawm hi. Na molhtum leh na ciangkhut in kei hong lungmuang sak hi.
Ka galte omna mai-ah kei’ ading an nong lui hi; ka lu sathau nong nilh a, ka hai a dimlet hi.
Hoihna leh hehpihna in ka khan’ tawntungin hong zui taktak ding a, Topa ’ inn sungah ka om tawntung ding hi.
